steps.player: Hello! You're not one of the hunters too, are you?

steps.npc: Oh no, but as someone that makes small soft versions of creatures, this is the place to be.
These books and the hunters' reports all contain lovely details about my subject matter. I might never leave!

steps.player: I'd imagine this is the place to be for materials too. These hunters seem to find everything!

steps.npc: The cat is a great way to stress test some of the stitching too. He loves having something to play with!
